# Russian release records

<a id="записи-выпусков--русские-версии"></a>

Russian counterparts of the [release notes and publication records](../README.md).
Published source, signed hashes and qualification history are preserved in both
languages. The application candidate remains a draft until release admission.

| Record | Scope |
|---|---|
| [Application 0.3.0](v0.3.0.md) | Candidate changes, upgrade/rollback, known limits and outstanding final verification |
| [Concurrency 0.3.0-rc.1](ioc-platform-concurrency-0.3.0-rc.1.md) | Original source, signing, repository publication and consumers |
| [Diagnostics 0.3.0-rc.1](ioc-platform-diagnostics-api-0.3.0-rc.1.md) | API scope, D0–D5 and immutable publication evidence |
| [Configuration 0.3.0-rc.1](ioc-config-spring-boot-0.3.0-rc.1.md) | Original Central CI failure, local recovery and pending protected CI follow-up |
| [Logging 0.3.0-rc.1](ioc-platform-logging-slf4j-0.3.0-rc.1.md) | API/Boot scope, historical corrections and original files |
| [Events core 0.3.0-rc.1](ioc-platform-events-0.3.0-rc.1.md) | JDK contracts and core-first publication |
| [Events Spring 0.3.0-rc.1](ioc-events-spring-0.3.0-rc.1.md) | Adapter corrections and original core/adapter qualification |

Historical application records [0.1.0](../v0.1.0.md) and [0.2.0](../v0.2.0.md)
remain English archives. Their original omissions and qualification limits are
retained, without claiming later checks for those releases.
